precondition: Experiment-wide PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE.json exists and lists the candidate. B0 must not be read otherwise.
training_policy: All fitted B0 models use the exact W17 TRAIN parameters (feature list, feature mean/std, coefficients, regularization) frozen in the DEV-stage artifact. W18 is used for selection/falsification only; no post-DEV parameter refit is allowed before B0.

005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.fit: Exact W17-trained absolute-size and relative-size OLS specifications frozen after W18 selection; no refit.
005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.b0_pass: relative-size B0 R2 > absolute-size B0 R2, relative-size B0 R2 > 0, and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound of the R2 difference > 0

005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.b0_pass: failed-minus-recovered aggressor-signed 30s continuation gap > 0 and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound > 0

005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.fit: same frozen without-replacement same-token matched-control algorithm
005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.b0_pass: at least 50 B0 pairs and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound of fill-minus-control aggressor-signed 30s move > 0

005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.fit: Exact W17-trained ridge logistic arrival model frozen after W18 selection; no refit.
005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.b0_pass: B0 AUC >= 0.60, both chronological halves AUC >= 0.55, and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% AUC bound > 0.50

005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.fit: Exact W17-trained ridge logistic BUY-vs-SELL model frozen after W18 selection; no refit.
005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.b0_pass: B0 AUC >= 0.58, at least 100 BUY and 100 SELL rows, both chronological halves AUC >= 0.52, and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% AUC bound > 0.50

005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.fit: Exact W17-trained state baseline and exact shortlisted OFI-or-microprice OLS challenger frozen after W18 selection; no refit.
005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.b0_pass: challenger B0 R2 exceeds baseline by at least 0.005, token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound of the improvement > 0, and the improvement remains positive under frozen stale-book and high-activity exclusions

multiple_testing_policy: Each candidate is an already frozen mechanism family from DEV; B0 is one-shot confirmation, not a new search. Report all evaluated candidates, including failures. No replacement candidates are allowed.
post_b0_policy: No retuning, rescue subsets, threshold changes, new interactions, feature additions, or repeated B0 execution for scientific selection.
deployment_boundary: A B0 pass is historical same-source confirmation only. It never directly authorizes MAKE or real SIG orders and remains FUTURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.
